mission: Build the mathematics corpus as a historical program in which equations, proofs, and methods carry origin stories and transmission paths.
organizing_rule: Important mathematical objects must later be teachable as both content and history.

eras.name: Antiquity
eras.focus: Number systems, arithmetic, geometric proof culture, and early rigorous work on magnitude and infinity.
canonical_works: Archimedes: On the Sphere and Cylinder

proof_threads.title: Pythagorean theorem
proof_threads.story_focus: Why area relations in right triangles became a central proving tradition.

proof_threads.title: Euclidean proof architecture
proof_threads.story_focus: How definitions, common notions, and postulates shaped formal proof culture.

proof_threads.title: Archimedean exhaustion and infinite reasoning
proof_threads.story_focus: How finite geometric reasoning approached areas, volumes, and limiting processes.

equation_threads.title: Right-triangle square relation
equation_threads.story_focus: A relation later written algebraically, but born in geometric language.

eras.name: Medieval Transmission and Synthesis
eras.focus: Indian and Arabic developments, transmission into Europe, algebraic procedure, and early infinite series ideas.
canonical_works: Al-Khwarizmi: Book on Addition and Subtraction after the Method of the Indians

proof_threads.title: Zero, sign rules, and arithmetic procedure
proof_threads.story_focus: How rules of calculation became explicit objects of mathematical writing.

proof_threads.title: Algebra as a procedural science
proof_threads.story_focus: How equation solving emerged as a textual procedure before symbolic algebra matured.

proof_threads.title: Infinite series before early modern calculus
proof_threads.story_focus: How summation ideas and approximation traditions prepared later analysis.

equation_threads.title: Place-value numeration and written calculation
equation_threads.story_focus: How numeral form reshaped what calculation itself could become.

equation_threads.title: Quadratic equation procedures before modern symbolism
equation_threads.story_focus: How verbal and geometric solution methods predated compact algebraic form.

eras.name: Early Modern Analysis and Chance
eras.focus: Calculus, notation, changing quantities, and the formal beginnings of probability.
canonical_works: Leibniz: Nova Methodus pro Maximis et Minimis
Pascal and Fermat correspondence on games of chance

proof_threads.title: Fluxions and differentials
proof_threads.story_focus: How two frameworks for change developed together yet with different notation and philosophy.

proof_threads.title: Integral and differential connection
proof_threads.story_focus: How accumulation and rate became linked in the emerging calculus tradition.

proof_threads.title: Probability from correspondence to method
proof_threads.story_focus: How questions about fair division and games produced general probabilistic reasoning.

equation_threads.title: Differential notation
equation_threads.story_focus: How notation changed the teachability and extensibility of calculus.

equation_threads.title: Integral sign lineage
equation_threads.story_focus: How accumulation became visually and conceptually encoded.

equation_threads.title: Early probability expressions
equation_threads.story_focus: How chance moved from concrete games to reusable mathematical language.

collection_rules: Do not ingest later modern sources before each early era has a stable anchor set of works and figures.
For every proof thread, store at least one origin-oriented story summary and one mathematics-oriented proof summary.
For every equation thread, store origin, notation, and later standard form separately.
Treat transmission between cultures as first-class historical data, not as a footnote.
